subject: general
concept: Awards and Honours, Books and Authors
question: Who has been awarded the Sahitya Akademi’s Bal Sahitya Puraskar 2025 in the Tamil language category for his children’s novel "Otrai Siragu Oviya"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishnupuram Saravanan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Vishnupuram Saravanan has been awarded the Sahitya Akademi’s Bal Sahitya Puraskar 2025 in the Tamil language category for his children’s novel "Otrai Siragu Oviya".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vishnupuram Saravanan received the Bal Sahitya Puraskar for his book "Otrai Siragu Oviya".**
 
• The novel blends elements of fantasy, ecology, and socio-political themes.
 
• The award is given annually by Sahitya Akademi for outstanding work in children’s literature in different languages.
 
• Bal Sahitya Puraskar__
 __
 
• Awarded annually by Sahitya Akademi to children’s authors for literary excellence in multiple languages.
 
• The award includes a casket with an engraved copper-plaque and a cash prize of Rs 50,000.
 
• Recognizes work across various Indian languages.
